channel.description: Recent content in Migration on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: Retirement: Support for Azure Functions OpenAI Extension ends on April 20, 2027
item.description:
Support for the Azure Functions OpenAI extension ends on April 20, 2027. Users should migrate to the appropriate direct SDKs before that date, including OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry, or Azure AI Search SDKs depending on the scenario.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Enterprise Live Migrations from Azure DevOps generally available
item.description:
Enterprise Live Migrations from Azure DevOps Services to GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency are now generally available. The feature lets organizations migrate repositories while teams continue working.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate Oracle databases to Azure Database for PostgreSQL using Azure Database Migration Service
item.description:
Azure Database Migration Service now supports offline migrations from Oracle to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The preview lets you configure source and target connections, choose schemas, start the transfer, and monitor migration status.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Cache for Redis to Azure Managed Redis migration tooling
item.description:
Azure has generally available built-in DNS migration tooling for moving endpoints from Azure Cache for Redis Basic, Standard, and Premium tiers to Azure Managed Redis. It redirects the existing cache hostname to an Azure Managed Redis endpoint to simplify migration.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate Azure Database for PostgreSQL to Azure HorizonDB with Azure Database Migration Service (DMS)
item.description:
Azure Database Migration Service (DMS) now supports migrating existing Azure Database for PostgreSQL workloads to Azure HorizonDB in public preview. The update extends DMS V2 architecture with HorizonDB as a migration target.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Azure Data Share will be retired on November 12, 2029
item.description:
Azure Data Share is scheduled for retirement on November 12, 2029. Users should migrate data sharing workloads to Microsoft Fabric or another appropriate source-specific sharing option before that date.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: dotnet: Modernize your .NET apps for Windows Arm64 with GitHub Copilot
item.description:
Microsoft announced guidance for using GitHub Copilot’s upgrade agent to modernize .NET apps for Windows Arm64, covering blocker identification, migration planning, and code changes. The post is a .NET Blog entry focused on the upgrade workflow.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: security: New investments to reduce on-premises security risk
item.description:
Microsoft announced a new on-premises security initiative that combines guidance, migration support, and product investments to reduce security risk in on-prem environments.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: commandline: Nine engineers, 1,211 pull requests in a day: Lessons from building Copilot Cowork
item.description:
Microsoft describes a case study from building Copilot Cowork, including a live migration of the runtime from Python to Rust. The article frames the migration as an example of the engineering practices used while shipping the system.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Large OS Disk Encryption for Azure Confidential VM migrations
item.description:
Large OS Disk Encryption (LOSDE) is now generally available for Azure Confidential VM migration scenarios. It enables migration of larger production workloads with the OS disk fully protected.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Migrate Azure Container Apps logging destination from Log Analytics to Azure Monitor
item.description:
Azure Container Apps now treats Log Analytics as a legacy logging destination. Existing environments will keep working, but users are advised to plan migration to Azure Monitor logging.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: dotnet: Get Your .NET MAUI App Ready for Xcode 27
item.description:
Microsoft published guidance for preparing existing .NET MAUI apps for Xcode 27. The post explains scene lifecycle changes and the manual migration steps needed to update apps.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: SQL Migration Agent Skills for assessment, migration, and validation
item.description:
SQL Migration Agent Skills are now generally available to help automate SQL Server to Azure migrations. They provide reusable AI-powered skills for assessment, target selection, migration execution, and post-migration validation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft SQL Agent Skills
item.description:
Microsoft SQL Agent Skills are in public preview. They provide product-specific guidance for AI agents used to build, operate, and migrate SQL workloads across Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Database container, and SQL Server migration scenarios.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Ubuntu 26 generally available and latest migration
item.description:
Ubuntu 26.04 runner images for GitHub Actions are now generally available and fully supported for production workflows on x64 and arm64. The release notes also mention a migration update.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agentless migration of on-premises SMB file shares to Azure Files (SMB)
item.description:
Azure Storage Mover now supports agentless migration of on-premises SMB file shares to Azure Files (SMB) in public preview. The migration can move data from Windows Server or NAS shares without deploying, registering, or maintaining a migration agent.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Enterprise Live Migrations from GHES to ghe.com generally available
item.description:
Enterprise Live Migrations is now generally available for near-zero-downtime repository migrations from GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) to GitHub Enterprise Cloud with Data Residency (GHEC DR).

  • Source: GitHub
